lemma tangent (H : Forest S.ratio) (p : Clip) (W : PathData G) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hg : PriceGap H p W a) (B C : Bed) (U : Matrix (Body 1 f) (Body 1 c) ℝ)
    (hd : Inputs S U (B.metric.acts f) (C.metric.acts c))
    (hq : Comptroller H B p W) (ρ) (h : Critical H p W ρ) (t : S.Choices) (x : Dir G c) :
    fderiv ℝ ρ 0 x = relative H U x := by

proof_context.conclusion: `fderiv ℝ ρ 0 x = relative H U x`: the branch derivative is the free interpolation relative to the copied field on the tree slice, given the normal equations `Inputs`.

snippet.text:
structure Inputs (S : StepData c f) (W : Matrix (Body 1 f) (Body 1 c) ℝ) (H : Matrix (Body 2 f) (Body 2 f) ℝ)
    (H' : Matrix (Body 2 c) (Body 2 c) ℝ) : Prop where
  primal : K H*W=(mean S).transpose*K H'
  dual : mean S*W=1-S.kernel.penalty⁻¹ • K H'

proof_context.conclusion: The normal equations `K H * W = (mean S)ᵀ * K H'` and `mean S * W = 1 - penalty⁻¹ • K H'` used by `test_pair`.

structure Scene (G : Gauge) (L : Side) (j : ℕ) (K : KernelChoices) (a : ℝ) : Prop where
  χ : ∃ η : ℝ, 0<η ∧ ∀ (c f : Side) (S : StepData c f), S.kernel=K → S.patch.L=L → S.patch.J=j → Larger (G:=G) S →
      ∀ (H : Forest S.ratio) (B C : Bed) (p q : Clip) (W : PathData G) (σ c₀ Λ m v u : ℝ) (T : Towers S.patch.L),
        Towers.Diagonal S B C T → Floor B p f a m → W.Bounds p σ c₀ Λ → Attached B W → Sworn B f G →
          Floor C q c v u → PriceGap H p W η ∧ ∃ ρ,Critical H p W ρ ∧ Guessed H (installed S.ratio T.A0) ρ ∧ HeatG H p W ρ C

proof_context.conclusion: `η` is chosen before `c f S` (volume-independent), while `ρ` with `Critical` and `Guessed` is produced for each choice.
